claims.source_quote_ar: وَأَنْ يَكُونَ حَالًا؛ أَيْ كَائِنِينَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ الْقُبُورِ.
claims.claim_ar: قد تكون جملة «مِنْ قَوْمِهِ» حالًا؛ أي بمعنى «كَائِنِينَ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ».
claims.claim_en: The phrase 'min qawmi-hi' may function as a ḥāl (circumstantial clause), i.e. 'being from his people'.

claims.claim_en: It is possible that 'min qawmi-hi' attaches to the verb (i.e., is dependent on the verb), analogous to readings where 'min ...' relates to a preceding verbal idea.
